title: What is the Measure of My Days?

questions.question: I said, "I will guard my ways, that I may not sin with my what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 39:1 (ESV): "I said, 'I will guard my ways, that I may not sin with my tongue;'"

questions.question: I will guard my mouth with a muzzle, so long as the wicked are in my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 39:1 (ESV): "...so long as the wicked are in my presence."

questions.question: O Lord, make me know my end and what is the measure of my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 39:4 (ESV): "O Lord, make me know my end and what is the measure of my days;"

questions.question: Behold, you have made my days a few handbreadths, and my lifetime is as nothing before whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 39:5 (ESV): "...and my lifetime is as nothing before you."

questions.question: And now, O Lord, for what do I wait? My hope is in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 39:7 (ESV): "And now, O Lord, for what do I wait? My hope is in you."

questions.question: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Do not make me the scorn of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 39:8 (ESV): "Do not make me the scorn of the fool!"

questions.question: I am mute; I do not open my mouth, for it is you who have done what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 39:9 (ESV): "...for it is you who have done it."

questions.question: Remove your stroke from me; I am spent by the hostility of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 39:10 (ESV): "...I am spent by the hostility of your hand."

questions.question: When you discipline a man with rebukes for sin, you consume like a moth what is dear to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 39:11 (ESV): "...you consume like a moth what is dear to him;"

questions.question: Surely all mankind stands as a mere what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 39:5 (ESV): "Surely all mankind stands as a mere breath!"

questions.question: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and give ear to my cry; hold not your peace at my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 39:12 (ESV): "...hold not your peace at my tears!"

questions.question: For I am a sojourner with you, a guest, like all my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 39:12 (ESV): "...a guest, like all my fathers."

questions.question: Look away from me, that I may smile again, before I depart and am no what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 39:13 (ESV): "Look away from me, that I may smile again, before I depart and am no more."

questions.question: Surely a man goes about as a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 39:6 (ESV): "Surely a man goes about as a shadow!"

questions.question: He heaps up wealth and does not know who will what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 39:6 (ESV): "he heaps up wealth and does not know who will gather!"

key_verse_text: And now, O Lord, for what do I wait? My hope is in you.
